import { Component } from '@angular/core'; @Component({ selector: 'app-services', standalone: true, template: `
Our Services

What We Build

From your idea to a live website in record time. We handle everything — design, development, hosting, and launch — so you can focus on your business.

🚀

Complete Launch & Setup

We don't just build websites — we launch your entire digital presence. From domain setup to hosting configuration, we handle every technical detail.

  • Domain & Hosting Setup
  • SSL Certificates
  • Email Configuration
  • Analytics Integration
💡

Your Vision + Our Expertise

Your ideas meet our technical skills. Romano and Maxel bring your concepts to life with practical solutions that actually work for your business.

  • Custom Design Solutions
  • Business Logic Integration
  • User Experience Optimization
  • Performance Tuning
⚡

Rapid Deployment

No endless development cycles. We use smart tools and proven processes to get your website live quickly without sacrificing quality.

  • 24-48 Hour Delivery
  • Quality Assurance
  • Mobile Optimization
  • Ongoing Support
`, styleUrls: ['./services.component.scss'] }) export class ServicesComponent {}
